rows.title: Slide clearance entered as 12.7 - 0.3 (box 0.6 mm too wide)
rows.why: Ball-bearing slides need >= 12.7 mm per side; 12.4 mm binds or will not engage.

rows.title: Handle c/c 790 on an 800 mm front
rows.why: Handle holes 5 mm from the edge; melamine blows out.

rows.title: 3 mm hardboard as bottom of an 800 mm wide drawer
rows.why: Bottom sags/pops out of the groove under 10-15 kg of clothes.

rows.title: Bottom groove 12 mm deep in an 18.8 mm drawer side
rows.why: Side breaks along the groove.

rows.title: Generator bug: drawer ends E1/E2 1 mm too long
rows.why: Box 1 mm wider than the slides allow: 12.5 mm per side, drawer binds.

rows.title: DXF: contour depth set to 18.5 on 18.8 mm boards
rows.why: Parts are not cut through; prying them out chips the melamine.

rows.title: DXF export dropped one Minifix-bolt hole
rows.why: One joint has no bolt; found during assembly, part must be re-drilled by hand.

rows.title: DXF: one part moved 30 mm into its neighbour
rows.why: Two parts overlap; the router cuts through both.

rows.title: DXF: one part moved 400 mm, off the sheet
rows.why: The part is cut in air/spoilboard; a whole sheet wasted.

rows.title: Gap between nested parts 4 mm with a 6.35 mm bit
rows.why: Neighbouring cuts merge; parts lose their edge and come loose mid-cut.

rows.title: Confirmat 5 mm from top edge of drawer side
rows.why: Screw splits the side.

rows.title: Gap between fronts 0 mm
rows.why: Fronts rub and chip each other.

rows.title: Handle screws M4x30 through 37.6 mm
rows.why: Screw does not reach the handle thread.

rows.title: Generator bug: bottom groove on E1 2 mm higher than on sides
rows.why: Bottom cannot enter all four grooves; box will not close square.

rows.title: Generator bug: Minifix bolt holes in the top forget the overhang
rows.why: Bolts land 21 mm off the side edge holes; top cannot be fitted.

rows.title: Generator bug: side bolt hole for the bottom at y = T instead of T/2
rows.why: Bolt misses the edge hole in the bottom by 9 mm.

rows.title: Plinth strip only 45 mm wide, 1400 mm long
rows.why: Narrow long part shifts under vacuum/hold-down and is ruined.

rows.title: Fronts flush to the bottom (edge 0) -> bottom drawer 1 mm above the carcass bottom
rows.why: Bottom drawer scrapes.

rows.title: 450 mm slide in a 430 mm carcass
rows.why: Slide does not fit.

rows.title: Fronts banded with 2 mm ABS (cut sizes not reduced)
rows.why: Gap between fronts goes from 3 mm to -1 mm; fronts collide.

rows.title: DXF: Minifix housing pocket depth 18.8 (through the board)
rows.why: Housing goes through the visible face.

rows.title: DXF header says inches
rows.why: VCarve imports the job 25.4x too big (or the operator rescales by guess).

rows.title: Generator bug: drawer bottom 4 mm too wide
rows.why: Bottom bottoms out in the groove; box cannot be closed.

rows.title: Regression: right side cut as an identical copy of the left (the bug found on 2026-11-22)
rows.why: Right side: band on the back edge, slide holes 30+ mm too far back; drawer cannot close square.
rows.source: found by R04 on the real kommode

rows.title: Regression: right drawer sides identical to left
rows.why: 8 right drawer sides get slide holes front<->back; slides cannot be mounted.
rows.source: found by R04 on the real kommode

rows.title: Minifix housing depth for 18 mm board drilled in 19 mm board (13.5)
rows.why: Cam sits 0.5 mm proud; bolt head misses the ramp, joint does not pull tight.
rows.source: Häfele TCH 2023 p 7.13

rows.title: Minifix edge bore only 20 mm deep with B24 housing
rows.why: Bolt head stops short of the cam; joint cannot be closed.
rows.source: Häfele TCH 2023 p 7.13/7.18

rows.title: Groove feed 3000 mm/min with 5.6 mm hardboard (groove cut with the 1/8" bit)
rows.why: Above Amana chipload for 1/8"; bit snaps mid-job or burns the groove.
rows.source: Amana compression spiral sheet v12

rows.title: Contour feed 6000 mm/min at 9.5 mm per pass
rows.why: Over Amana 1/4" limit for 1.5xD passes; chipped melamine, deflection, broken bit.
rows.source: Amana compression spiral sheet v12

rows.title: Slide holes typed in from another length (KA 4532/400 with 37/165/357)
rows.why: Rear screw misses the runner hole; runner sits crooked.
rows.source: Hettich MS 10547 p2

rows.title: 1 mm ABS banding on the fronts, cut sizes not reduced
rows.why: Fronts grow 2 mm each way; the 3 mm gap closes to 1 mm and fronts rub.
rows.source: Microvellum KB, cut size = finished - band

rows.title: Onion skin 1.5 mm
rows.why: Parts do not separate; tearing them out chips the melamine face.
rows.source: ShopBot hold-down guide p8

rows.title: Vacuum table only, small drawer parts without tabs
rows.why: Small parts move in the last pass and get gouged.
rows.source: ShopBot hold-down guide p7

rows.title: Slide screws Ø4x10
rows.why: Only 8.8 mm in chipboard; runner pulls out under load.
rows.source: Hettich MS 10547 p1

rows.title: Minifix housing 34 mm from the edge with B24 bolts (24 mm system)
rows.why: Minifix 15 comes in drilling distance B24 and B34; the bolt length is matched to the distance. With the housing 10 mm further in than the bolt reaches, the cam turns past the bolt head and the joint never pulls tight (or the operator over-tightens and cracks the chipboard).
rows.source: Häfele Minifix 15 catalogue / drilling template: housing distance B24 vs B34 must match the bolt type

rows.title: Dowel holes 12 mm (face) + 15 mm (edge) = 27 mm for 8x35 dowels
rows.why: Hole depths must add up to dowel length + ~2 mm glue/air space. With 27 mm the 8x30/8x35 dowel bottoms out and the carcass joint stays open 5-8 mm; Minifix cannot close it either and the edge splits.
rows.source: Dowel joint practice (Häfele/Würth dowel tables, Festool/Wolfcraft dowel jig manuals): face depth + edge depth = dowel length + 1-2 mm; 8 mm dowel in 19 mm board: ~12 face / ~22-25 edge

rows.title: Oak decor board marked "no grain direction" -> nester rotates parts 90°
rows.why: Kaindl oak decor has a printed grain. With rotation allowed the nester turns one side panel 90° on the sheet (653x430 instead of 430x653): the two visible sides get grain in different directions and one must be re-cut from a new oak sheet.
rows.source: Woodworking/nesting practice (VCarve/Cutlist "grain direction lock", panel-saw cutting lists): decor and veneer boards must keep grain orientation

rows.title: Slide screws 20 mm long into 18.8 mm carcass sides
rows.why: Screw goes 18.8 mm into an 18.8 mm side: the tip lifts or pierces the finished OUTER face of the oak side (visible). Hettich/Blum specify 3.5x15/16 chipboard or 6.3x13 Euro screws for side mount slides in 16-19 mm.
rows.source: Hettich KA 4532 / Blum mounting instructions: screw length for side-mount slides in 16-19 mm panels; common forum failure "screw came through the side of the cabinet"

rows.title: Slide hole pattern from the INSET drawing (+19 mm) on an overlay kommode
rows.why: Cabinet member sits 19 mm further back while the drawer member is unchanged: the closed position is 19 mm deeper than the carcass front, so the overlay front hits the carcass edge 19 mm before the slide reaches its stop. Self/soft-close never engages and the drawer springs open.
rows.source: Hettich/Blum slide mounting instructions give separate setback dimensions for overlay vs inset fronts (inset: add front thickness); mixing them is a common cabinet-maker error

rows.title: Edge band added on the top edge of the sides (joint edge) without shortening the part
rows.why: The top sits on the banded edge: sides become 1-2 mm taller than the middle wall, top rocks/gaps, and the Minifix/dowel edge holes are drilled through ABS which chips and misaligns.
rows.source: Edge-banding practice (Homag/Biesse banding guides, cutlist rules): never band edges that are joined; if you must, deduct band thickness from the cut size

rows.title: Slide holes on middle wall 3 mm higher than on the opposite side
rows.why: Each drawer hangs on two slides; if the carcass members are not at the same height the box is twisted, the ball cages bind and the drawer racks or drops off one rail. Hettich/Blum: both runners in one plane, tolerance <=0.5 mm.
rows.source: Hettich KA/Quadro mounting instructions; System 32 line-boring practice

rows.title: Zero gap (fuge) between drawer fronts
rows.why: Fronts touch: edge banding rubs, ABS chips, fronts cannot open past each other and any 0.5 mm swelling or slide sag locks the stack. Overlay fronts need 2-3 mm reveals.
rows.source: Kitchen/overlay front reveal rules (Blum: 2-3 mm gap)

rows.title: Plinth strip placed on top of the leg mounting positions
rows.why: Bunnlist at y=70..89 runs straight through the 40x40 leg plates at y=60..100 near both ends: legs cannot be screwed on, or the strip must be notched by hand.
rows.source: Leg/plinth layout under carcass bottoms (Ikea/Hafele leg plates)

rows.title: Front fixing screws placed exactly on the handle bolt line
rows.why: The 4x30 screw through the drawer end sits where the handle M4 bolt has to pass (front centre, 96 mm off centre): the bolt hits the screw, the handle cannot be fitted.
rows.source: Drawer front attachment practice: keep fixing screws clear of handle bores

rows.title: Bottom groove only 3 mm above lower edge of drawer parts
rows.why: A 3 mm strip of particleboard under a 6.4 mm groove breaks off when the router passes or when the loaded HDF bottom pushes down. Typical minimum 8-12 mm.
rows.source: Drawer box construction (groove 10-12 mm up), particleboard edge strength

rows.title: Groove clearance typed with a minus sign: groove narrower than the HDF
rows.why: Groove 5.6 mm for a 5.9 mm bottom: the bottom cannot be slid in; forcing it splits the groove lips.
rows.source: Sign/typo error in parameters; groove must be board + 0.3-0.5 mm

rows.title: Drawer board thickness measured on the wrong (16 mm) sheet
rows.why: Measured 15.8 on a nominal 19 board: every drawer end is 6 mm too long, boxes are too wide for the slide clearance, grooves and confirmat positions are wrong. A >3 mm deviation is a measurement mix-up, not tolerance.
rows.source: Measuring the wrong offcut/sample; sheet-goods thickness tolerance is +-0.3 mm

rows.title: Dowel only 10 mm from the Minifix bolt
rows.why: Ø8 dowel at 60 next to Ø5 Minifix bolt at 50: 3.5 mm web between bores on the face and on the end edge; the particleboard between them crumbles and neither fitting holds.
rows.source: Hafele/Hettich connector spacing: keep >=32 mm (System 32) between connector and dowel

rows.title: Oak decor grain flag lost: fronts/top/sides nested rotated
rows.why: Kaindl Eik Dew has a grain direction; with retning=False the nester rotates parts freely - here the right side CH is nested turned 90 deg, so its grain runs vertically while the left side runs horizontally. Visible on the finished piece, cannot be fixed after cutting.
rows.source: Decor/veneer grain direction in nesting software (grain lock)

rows.title: Side panel slide holes referenced from the back edge
rows.why: Slide pilots on the left side C at DEP-x instead of x from the front (C now looks like the mirrored CH): the left runners sit ~36 mm further back than the middle-wall runners, the drawer cannot be mounted square and the front will not close flush.
rows.source: Wrong reference edge / origin in CNC programs (front-edge reference for slides)

rows.title: Drawer-side slide holes 12 mm too low on the box
rows.why: Box-member holes on the left drawer sides (S) are 12 mm off the box centre while the right sides (SH) are correct: every box hangs tilted, the bottom drawer drags on the carcass bottom and fronts are skewed.
rows.source: Box-member mounting height vs cabinet-member height (Hettich/Blum)

rows.title: Top dowel/Minifix holes miss the front overhang offset
rows.why: Holes in the top ignore the 21 mm overhang: the top sits flush with the carcass front, so the 18.8 mm drawer fronts stand proud of the top and the top hangs 24 mm over the back.
rows.source: Offset/reference error between mating parts (top vs side edge bores)

rows.title: Minifix cam housings in the bottom at 34 mm instead of 24 mm
rows.why: The cam must sit at the bolt-head distance (24 mm for this bolt). At 34 mm the bolt head does not reach the cam: no clamping, the carcass joint is loose.
rows.source: Hafele Minifix 15 drilling data (dimension B = 24 mm)

rows.title: Middle wall cut full side height (bottom thickness not subtracted)
rows.why: Middle wall stands on the bottom but is cut 653 mm: 18.8 mm too tall, the top cannot come down onto the sides and all Minifix joints at the top stay open.
rows.source: Classic carcass arithmetic error (forgot one board thickness)

rows.title: Drawer bottom 2 mm too large in both directions
rows.why: Bottom is 1 mm per side deeper than the groove bottoms: the box cannot be closed, or is forced out of square / bows the sides.
rows.source: Panel-in-groove sizing (groove depth minus play)

rows.title: Drawer box 2 mm too wide for the slides
rows.why: Ends/bottom 2 mm long: 1 mm less than the 12.7 mm slide clearance per side. Ball-bearing slides tolerate +-0.2 mm; the drawer jams or the slide must be forced.
rows.source: Hettich KA 4532 / Accuride: side clearance 12.7 +0.2/-0

rows.title: Only 7 drawer fronts generated for 8 drawers
rows.why: Off-by-one in quantity: cut list and sheets both say 7, one drawer has no front. Found at assembly, a second oak sheet run for one part.
rows.source: Off-by-one quantity bugs in cut lists

rows.title: Sheet exported in inches but header still says mm
rows.why: All coordinates on the drawer-parts sheet are 25.4x too small while $INSUNITS=4 (mm). The CAM imports tiny parts; if scaled by guess, everything is off.
rows.source: DXF unit mismatch (VCarve/ShopBot import scale)

rows.title: Minifix housing pockets drilled through the oak sides
rows.why: Layer depth for Ø15 cam housings written as Z18.8 (full thickness) instead of Z13.5: Ø15 holes through the visible outside of both side panels.
rows.source: Layer-encoded depth errors in CAM templates

rows.title: Contour depth set for 16 mm board on 18.8 mm sheet
rows.why: Profile depth Z16 leaves 2.8 mm uncut: parts are not freed, have to be broken/cut out by hand, edges chip and the parts may shift during later ops.
rows.source: Reusing a toolpath template from a thinner material

rows.title: One drawer back (E2) missing from its sheet
rows.why: Sheet has 7 E2 while the cut list says 8: one box has no back, second machine run.
rows.source: Part count on sheet vs cut list mismatch (manual nest edit)

rows.title: Part placed beyond the sheet edge
rows.why: The rightmost part on the oak sheet extends 40 mm past the 2440 mm sheet: the bit cuts air or the clamps/bed, part comes out short.
rows.source: Manual nest edits / bed size mismatch

rows.title: Oak sheet exported mirrored (Y flipped)
rows.why: All hole patterns are mirrored inside their parts (origin top-left vs bottom-left): top dowels at the wrong distance from the front, slide holes top/bottom swapped on the sides.
rows.source: Mirror/flip on DXF export or wrong CAM origin corner

rows.title: Blind holes exported with radius = diameter
rows.why: Circles on 01_BOR layers are twice the size: Ø5 Minifix bolt bores become Ø10, Ø8 dowels Ø16 - nothing holds, and the CAM may pocket them.
rows.source: Radius/diameter confusion in DXF writers

rows.title: Labels swapped between a front end (E1) and a back end (E2)
rows.why: The part labelled E1 has no front fixing holes and the one labelled E2 has them: built into the wrong position, the front cannot be screwed on.
rows.source: Mislabelled parts on nested sheets
